summary: Concejo AB (publ) engages in the design and delivery of safety systems for active firefighting. It operates through Concejo Industries and SBF Fonder segments. The company offers preventive, detection, alarm, firefighting, and support system solutions; testing and system maintenance; spare parts; and consulting services, such as technical calculation, design, risk analysis, and training services. It also provides optical gas detectors; fluorine-free and biodegradable firefighting foam; and ship logs, marine tachographs, and positioning systems. In addition, the company operates as a manager of alternative investment ¬funds that offers investors co-ownership in Swedish residential properties. It serves the oil and gas, marine, mining, energy and power, aerospace, and petrochemical plant industries. The company operates in Sweden, Norway, Turkey, the Netherlands, Spain, Greece, Italy, France, Germany, Great Britain, rest of Europe, Canada, the United States, Mexico, South Korea, Singapore, Japan, India, China, Kazakhstan, the United Arab Emirates, rest of Asia, Nigeria, Morocco, rest of Africa, Australia, Brazil, and rest of South America. The company was formerly known as Consilium AB (publ) and changed its name to Concejo AB (publ) in December 2020. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Nacka, Sweden. Concejo AB (publ) operates as a subsidiary of Platanen Holding Ab.
ceo: Mr. Carl Adam Rosenblad L.L.B., LL.B. M.Sc, M.Sc, M.Sc.
